inventory_controls.observed: Article editor opened with captured Markdown. Applied GUEST99 APPLY MARKER over 'stable sample page'; Article rendered the marker and EDITED badge, word count changed 179 to 205.

Edited draft to CANCEL-MARKER then Cancel. Article remained unchanged; original 'This stable sample page...' text remained rendered. A preliminary no-op Cancel was also used before the corrected marker attempt.

Initial Links count 17. Copy URL on first captured link produced a Copy URL toast; pasting into Chrome address bar (without submitting) showed https://www.aimatrx.com/, matching the selected first link. Blank href Add left the form open and count 17. Added https://example.com/guest99-link-marker with text GUEST99 LINK MARKER; rendered row appeared and count became 18. Remove link removed the marker and count returned to 17.

link_edit_surface: No edit action was exposed on existing Link rows (only Copy URL and Remove link). Add link exposed editable href and optional text fields; the test added and removed a disposable row. The documented EXT-F-1007-C13/T13 procedure asks for add/copy/remove and does not require editing an existing row.
restore: After row removal, Re-capture prompted to discard unsaved edits. Confirmed recapture; Article returned to original 179 words without EDITED badge and Links returned to original count 17. Save was never clicked, no Source write or AI call occurred, no link was opened, and no persistent page modification occurred.
evidence: Native Chrome accessibility snapshots showed Profile 10, dev extension origin ID, Guest account, Capture result panes, editor text and Apply/Cancel controls, Links form fields, counts, marker row, and restored original content.
Native screenshot showed the Links pane and row action controls.
Clipboard pasteback in the address bar showed the copied URL; navigation was canceled with Escape and the demo URL restored.
